title: Pull the bad potatoes out of a row another robot arm is crating
instruction: Put the two potatoes with dark spots in the red bin before the other arm crates them.
context: On a line where one worker packs everything that reaches them, the person beside them has to pull the bad items first, without stopping or getting in the way of the packer. This checks that a policy can do that beside an arm on a fixed routine that will not wait for it.
setup: A 90 x 90 cm wooden table top, 75 cm high. Two YAM arms stand side by side at the back edge, 50 cm apart; the controlled arm is the right one in the screenshot. Distances are from the midpoint between the two arm bases: forward, and sideways toward the controlled arm (negative: toward the other arm). Trays and bins have 1.2 cm walls. A grey tray 6 x 36 cm inside, 30 cm forward, running sideways across the centre line. In it, a row of six tan 3 cm potato cubes (80 g each) at -15, -9, -3, 3, 9 and 15 cm sideways; the two at -9 and 9 cm are bad, with a dark spot 1.8 cm across on top. A brown crate 16 x 18 cm inside, 33 cm forward and 30 cm toward the other arm; a red reject bin the same size, 33 cm forward and 30 cm toward the controlled arm. From 6 s in, the other arm crates the potatoes in order from its own end of the row, good or bad, one about every 7 s, without waiting or looking. It does the same in every trial.
scoring: The share of the two bad potatoes in the red bin at the end (0, 0.5 or 1). 0 if a good potato is in the red bin or anywhere but the tray and the crate, or if the two arms ever touch. The run stops at a touch, and 1 s after the score first holds at 1.
reset_notes: Put the six potatoes back in the row, the spotted ones second from each end.
fidelity: Approximate. The potatoes are 3 cm rigid cubes, the bad ones marked by a painted spot, not real potatoes. Arm links collide as fitted capsules slightly larger than the real ones, so a near miss under about 1 cm can count as a touch. The gripper pinches with up to 50 N through flat pads. The other arm's routine is planned once from the fixed layout and replayed open loop.
